calculation_handling.description: Permits repair or reconstruction of a non-complying building damaged beyond the owner's control, if the non-compliance does not grow.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs as-built facts about the existing building and the cause of damage.

calculation_handling.description: Permits an unsafe portion of a non-complying building to be repaired or restored to a safe condition, without increasing the non-compliance or moving any part unless a minor variance allows it.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs as-built facts and the City's unsafe-condition determination.

calculation_handling.description: Exception to the ban on building below a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank: an ancillary building on a residential lot is allowed there.
calculation_handling.gaps: The shoreline hazard limit or top-of-bank line is set by the TRCA and is not held in our lot data.

calculation_handling.description: Exception to the ban on building below a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank: conservation works, public utilities and transportation uses are allowed there.
calculation_handling.gaps: The shoreline hazard limit or top-of-bank line is set by the TRCA and is not held in our lot data.

calculation_handling.description: A lawfully existing building below a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank stays permitted, and may be altered or replaced in the same place if its lawful height, length or width does not increase.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs as-built facts and the TRCA line, neither held in our lot data.

calculation_handling.description: On a heritage designated site, work authorised by a Heritage Permit must follow the permit, and the zone's building regulations do not stop work done in compliance with it.
calculation_handling.gaps: Heritage Permit terms are not held in our lot data.

5.10.40.1(1).explanation: A lawfully existing building that does not comply with the zone rules and is damaged or destroyed by something outside the owner's control may be rebuilt or repaired, as long as the non-compliance does not increase.

5.10.40.1(2).explanation: If the City finds a non-complying building unsafe, the unsafe part may be repaired or restored without increasing the non-compliance. It cannot be moved unless a minor variance authorizes it.

5.10.40.1(3).explanation: On Toronto and Region Conservation Authority lands where a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank crosses a lot, nothing may be built below that line. Exceptions are ancillary buildings on residential lots and conservation works, public utilities and transportation uses.

5.10.40.1(4).explanation: A lawfully existing building already below a shoreline hazard limit or stable top-of-bank may stay. It may be altered or rebuilt in the same place if its lawful height, length and width do not increase.

5.10.40.1(6).explanation: On a heritage designated site, work that needs a Heritage Permit must follow that permit. The zone's building regulations do not block work done in line with the permit.
